name: Path Traversal / Local File Read
steps: Find every input that selects a file or path (download, include, template, attachment, export).
Inject traversal sequences and absolute paths; vary the depth and the encoding to defeat filters.
Target sensitive, predictable files appropriate to the detected OS and application.
Confirm by retrieving the contents of a file outside the intended directory.
Chain to source/config disclosure, then to recovered secrets or to code execution.
